title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Developer Productivity
Senior AI Engineer, Finance AI & Automation
description_html: Application Deadline:         11/29/2026     Address: 320 S Canal Street     Job Family Group: Data Analytics & Reporting     BMO is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and run production-grade AI solutions across Finance. You will own solutions end to end:   user experience and APIs  agentic workflows  retrieval and data integration  evaluation and ongoing monitoring    You will build on BMO's enterprise AI platform and within the Finance AI Governance Program. Your work will be safe and auditable, and it will hold up to regulatory review.   You will partner directly with leaders in FP&A, Controllership, Treasury and Finance Operations. Typical use cases include:   variance analysis and commentary  reconciliations and manual journal entries  close acceleration  controllership and policy research  treasury forecasting    This role is for engineers who have shipped AI to production, not only built prototypes.   Why join:   Shape how AI changes Finance at one of North America's largest banks, working with senior Finance leadership.  Build real solutions that go to production, on an enterprise AI platform designed for scale and governance.  Help set engineering and Responsible AI standards for the Finance AI function.    Key accountabilities   Solution engineering    Design, build and deploy end-to-end AI applications: web front ends (React/TypeScript), backend services and APIs (Python/FastAPI), and integration with Finance data and systems.  Translate Finance business problems into technical designs, and make sound trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost and maintainability.    Agentic AI and LLM systems    Build multi-step agentic workflows using tool and function calling, MCP integrations, and orchestration frameworks.  Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over Finance policies, documents and structured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search and context engineering.  Embed human-in-the-loop controls for material judgments, approvals and financial postings.    Evaluation and quality    Build evaluation harnesses with golden datasets to measure accuracy, consistency, groundedness and regression across model and prompt changes.  Document methodology, assumptions and limitations. Define acceptance thresholds with business owners.    Production readiness and operations    Partner with the Technology and AI Platform teams on CI/CD, security reviews, resilience and support handover.  Use the shared enterprise platform services (AI gateway, guardrails, registry, observability) rather than building parallel tooling.  Instrument tracing, usage, cost and drift monitoring. Respond to and resolve production issues.    Governance, risk and data controls    Act as the AI Developer under the Risk and Finance AI Governance Program: complete use case documentation, testing evidence and Ongoing Monitoring Plans address conditions raised in Second Line reviews  Apply data classification, access controls, PII protection and lineage, in line with the Data Risk Directive, RDARR principles and model risk expectations.    Adoption and leadership    Run demos and pilots, gather feedback, and track adoption and value-realization metrics.  Build reusable patterns, components and templates that speed up future Finance AI use cases.  Review code, set engineering standards, and mentor analysts and junior engineers.   Qualifications   Required    7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and deploying LLM or generative AI applications to production.  Expert Python, plus proficiency in a modern front-end framework (React/TypeScript preferred).  Strong API design, SQL and data modeling skills.  Hands-on experience with: agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or equivalent) RAG architectures and vector databases prompt and context engineering  Experience with cloud AI services (Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry and/or AWS Bedrock), containers, CI/CD and observability tooling.  Proven ability to evaluate non-deterministic systems and build automated test and evaluation pipelines.  Experience in a regulated environment, with an understanding of auditability, explainability, security and data privacy.  Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical Finance stakeholders and senior leaders.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience.    Preferred    Finance domain knowledge: financial close, reconciliations, FP&A, treasury, liquidity or IRRBB.  Familiarity with model risk management guidance (e.g., OSFI E-23, SR 11-7).  Experience with Databricks, Snowflake or Power BI, and with Finance systems such as Oracle or Hyperion.  Experience building MCP servers or enterprise tool integrations for agents.  Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) within a governed engineering workflow.  Bilingual English/French is an asset.           Researches, builds, and implements scalable artificial intelligence systems capable of learning and making predictions to business requirements. Enhances data pipelines and lakes to ensure data is clean, accurate, and optimized for machine learning models. Monitors, evaluates, and optimizes learning processes to continuously improve high-performance models. Works with other data and analytics professionals to optimize, refine, automate and scale analysis into repeatable analytics solutions and decision support tools.   Designs and develops machine learning (ML) and deep learning systems.  Runs machine learning tests and experiments. Trains and retrain systems to prevent drift and optimize results.  Solves complex problems with multi-layered data sets, extends existing ML frameworks and optimizes existing machine learning libraries.  Develops Machine Learning apps, implements algorithms, and builds tools to apply ML frameworks.  Turns unstructured data into useful information by auto-tagging images and text-to-speech conversions.  Develops ML algorithms to analyze huge volumes of historical data to make predictions.  Runs tests, performs statistical analysis, and interprets test results.  Operates at a group/enterprise-wide level and serves as a specialist resource to senior leaders and stakeholders.  Applies expertise and thinks creatively to address unique or ambiguous situations and to find solutions to problems that can be complex and non-routine.  Implements changes in response to shifting trends.  Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.  Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.      Qualifications:    Intermediate level of proficiency:    Systems Thinking.    Advanced level of proficiency:    Mathematics, Statistics & Operations Research.  Critical thinking.  Creative reasoning.  Computational Thinking and Programming.  Deep Learning.  Machine Learning.  Scaling Models.  Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment.  ML algorithm.  Verbal & written communication skills.  Analytical and problem solving skills.  Influence skills.  Collaboration & team skills; with a focus on cross-group collaboration.  Able to manage ambiguity.  Data driven decision making.  Typically 7+ years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  Seasoned professional with a combination of education, experience and industry knowledge.       Salary   :    $120,000.00 - $250,000.00    Pay Type:   Salaried   The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.    Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.    BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit:     https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards          About Us      At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.    As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact.  We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers.  We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.    To find out more visit us at    http://jobs.bmo.com/us/en       BMO is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. We also consider applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.    BMO is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to    BMOCareers.Support@bmo.com    and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.    Note to Recruiters: BMO does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to BMO, directly or indirectly, will be considered BMO property. BMO will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.          The Experience     AI agents are changing how work gets done. Making them useful requires intuitive, reliable experiences that let people guide decisions, respond to requests and take action within their everyday tools.  We’re building interfaces that bring people and agents together across business workflows. You’ll help shape how users collaborate with AI, combining customer-facing product development with the engineering foundations needed to support enterprise customers.   The Team  The Human Agent Interfaces (HAI) team builds the surfaces where people and agents work together, including notifications, task interactions, conversational and Copilot experiences, and the tools agents use to act on workflows.  We’re a small team with broad ownership and a fast pace. You’ll work across the stack and own features from design and prototyping through implementation, rollout and customer feedback. Our work spans React, TypeScript, backend services, GraphQL, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and integrations with Microsoft Teams, Slack and email.      What You’ll Actually Be Doing      Design, build and ship intuitive experiences that help people and AI agents collaborate on business workflows.    Develop full-stack features across web applications, conversational interfaces and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack and email.    Build APIs and agent tooling using technologies such as GraphQL, REST and MCP to connect users, agents and workflows.    Create consistent interaction patterns that let users stay informed, provide input and complete work across channels.    Build secure, reliable integrations, including authentication, authorization, notifications and account connectivity.    Develop conversational and agentic experiences, using evaluations and customer feedback to improve quality and reliability.    Own the feature lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through staged rollout, production operation and iteration.  Shared Responsibilities:     Partner with Product, Design, Customer Success and customers to translate needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.    Write design documents and RFCs, build prototypes and communicate technical tradeoffs.    Raise engineering quality through code review, automated testing, documentation and operational excellence.    Use AI coding tools effectively and critically evaluate generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.    Mentor engineers and contribute to a collaborative team with strong technical judgment and shared ownership.  Long-Term Strategic Impact:     Shape the architecture and technical direction of interfaces that connect people, agents and business processes.    Establish reusable patterns for integrations, interaction models and agent tooling as the product grows.    Improve scalability, observability and reliability while keeping the team’s ability to deliver quickly.    Help turn customer insights and emerging AI capabilities into a coherent product experience.       You’re Our Person If…      You have 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering production software, with scope and technical leadership appropriate to the Senior, Lead or Principal level.    You have strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern backend language such as Go, Java or Python.    You have experience building customer-facing web applications with React or a comparable framework.    You have designed and implemented GraphQL or REST APIs and integrated with third-party services using webhooks and asynchronous communication.    You understand authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, SSO and secure service integration.    You have experience building and operating distributed systems or SaaS applications on a public cloud.    You take ownership from ambiguous requirements through production delivery, including monitoring and controlled releases.    You communicate clearly in writing and technical discussions, and collaborate effectively across engineering and product functions.    You use AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering standards.       Even Better If…      You have experience with MCP, LLM tool-calling, agent frameworks or evaluation-driven development.    You have built applications or integrations for Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Slack or email.    You have worked on conversational interfaces, notification systems or products that coordinate human and automated work.    You have experience with workflow engines, business process automation or task-management products.    You have hands-on experience with Go, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.    You have helped build a product from an early stage or worked on a small team balancing rapid delivery with enterprise reliability.              Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.       In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. title: Senior Software Engineer, Crusoe Managed Data Transfer
description_html:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe's Managed Platform Services (MAPS) organization builds the managed services that make Crusoe Cloud easy to adopt and hard to leave, including Crusoe Container Registry, Cloud Monitoring and Managed Logs. Managed Data Transfer (MDT) is its newest service. MDT moves petabyte-scale training data from AWS S3, and later other clouds, into Crusoe storage with a single API call: the service shards the work across a fleet of transfer workers, verifies every object, and asks the customer to run nothing. For AI labs and Physical AI companies whose data lives with a hyperscaler, it removes one of the biggest obstacles to training on Crusoe GPUs.



We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the MDT control plane: the job API, scheduler and job state that turn a customer request into a coordinated, resumable transfer. You will join a new team at the beginning, take the service from first commit to its preview launch with design-partner customers, and shape the API that new clouds and Crusoe-internal transfers will plug into later. You will work closely with the Storage, Network, IAM and Cloud Console teams, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Job API and Lifecycle: Design and build the data-transfer API (create, list, get, cancel) with a provider-neutral model for sources and destinations, so new clouds and storage types can be added without breaking customers.

 - Scheduling and Job State: Build the scheduler and state machine that split a bucket listing into units of work, place them on regional worker pools, and track progress, retries and resume across failures.

 - Correctness at Scale: Make petabyte-scale jobs safe to retry and cancel, with end-to-end checksum verification and clear errors when a customer's permissions or destination are wrong.

 - Cross-Cloud Identity: Implement secure access to customer buckets with short-lived, least-privilege credentials (AWS role assumption first, other clouds next), integrated with Crusoe IAM and audit logging.

 - Customer Surfaces: Ship the CLI and, with partner teams, the Terraform and Console experiences for creating and monitoring transfers.

 - Operational Excellence: Instrument the service with metrics, logs and alerts, write the runbooks, and take part in the team's on-call rotation.

 - Cross-Team Collaboration: Agree the interfaces MDT depends on with Storage, Network, IAM and Console, and work with Product and Solutions Architects on early customer onboarding.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Backend Engineering Craft: Experience designing and shipping production backend services and APIs, ideally in Go, with gRPC or REST, relational databases and Kubernetes.

 - Professional Experience: 5+ years building cloud infrastructure or platform services, including taking a service from zero to general availability.

 - Distributed Systems Judgment: Comfort with long-running, failure-prone work: idempotency, retries with backoff, leases, checkpointing and partial failure.

 - API Design: Ability to design public APIs that customers automate against and that can grow without breaking changes.

 - Security Mindset: Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and least privilege, and care in handling customer credentials.

 - Operational Ownership: You have run services in production, been on call, and built the dashboards and alerts that keep incidents short.

 - Collaboration and Writing: You work well across teams with different priorities, and your design docs settle decisions.

 - Educational Foundation: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
   
   

Bonus Points

 - Experience with large-scale data movement, such as S3 multipart uploads, rclone, s5cmd, AWS DataSync or Google Storage Transfer Service.

 - Hands-on experience with cross-cloud identity: AWS IAM and STS, GCP service-account impersonation, or Azure workload identity.

 - Experience with storage systems (object storage, NFS, parallel file systems) or high-throughput networking.

 - Experience with job orchestration systems such as Temporal, Argo, or Kubernetes operators.

 - Experience building on GPU or AI infrastructure.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $205,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Our users count on our platform to be highly reliable, lightning fast, supremely secure, and to preserve all of their customizations and integrations every time we ship. Good knowledge of Linux internals.    Proven professional work experience with Python. In-depth understanding of OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and concurrency.    Public cloud engineering on GCP, AWS, and or Azure platforms. Cloud provisioning, infrastructure, and migration at cloud scale.    Use of AI assisted development tools to automate DNS and infrastructure management.    Solid understanding of configuring, deploying, managing, and maintaining large cloud-hosted systems.    Experience with container and orchestration systems like Kubernetes, Docker, etc.    Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Splunk, Puppet, Spinnaker, Terraform, git, etc.    Strong understanding of fundamental network technologies like DNS, Load Balancing, SSL, TCP/IP, SQL, HTTP, Switches, Routers.    CI/CD experience with tools like Jenkins, and Travis CI.    Implementation experience of large infrastructure projects.    A continuous learner, a critical thinker, and a team player with excellent communication skills.    Embrace a culture and work environment that promotes diversity and inclusion.    Configuration management with open-source tools, ideally Puppet, Chef, Salt, or Ansible.    Experience maintaining monitoring platforms like Grafana.    Experience with Agile development methodology and Test Driven Development        Even Better If You Have:       Experience using AWS Route 53.    Working in high-availability, 24x7x365 large-scale multi-datacenter environment    Highly skilled in packet analysis, network analysis tools, troubleshooting, and analytical fault diagnosis.    Security hardening of network infrastructure, such as DNSSEC             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Full Stack Engineer 5
description_html: Full Stack Engineer 5       Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking  Full-stack Software Engineers  who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One.      Join the Navigator Platform Team at Capital One and help revolutionize the fintech landscape by enhancing our industry-leading Auto Navigator and Lead Navigator platforms. In this dynamic environment, you will leverage cutting-edge technology to streamline auto financing and lead management, directly impacting the car-buying experience for millions. By spearheading these intuitive, customer-centric solutions, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving technological advancements that make our processes more efficient and accessible.       What You’ll Do:         Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company      Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community      Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment      Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services      Provide technical leadership across multiple teams, shaping system architecture and long-term technology direction      Drive end-to-end design and implementation of large-scale, distributed, or cloud-native systems with high reliability and performance requirements      Partner with architects and product leaders to define platform roadmaps and shared services strategy        This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.        Basic Qualifications:        Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)      At least 6 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)      At least 3 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies         Preferred Qualifications:         Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field      9+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala       5+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks      5+ years of experience with front-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks      5+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs      4+ years of experience with database and database management systems      4+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies      4+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks      4+ years of experience using Git-based version-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket)      4+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments      3+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams      2+ years of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems      1+ year of experience leading architectural design reviews and influencing enterprise-wide technical standards and methodologies      1+ year of experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams      1+ year of experience implementing observability and reliability practices at scale      Experience leveraging modern AI-based coding tools and IDE copilots       Experience influencing technology strategy at the portfolio or business unit level      Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion      Experience leading cross-functional engineering efforts or large-scale technical initiatives          Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. Plano, TX: $209,000 - $238,500 for Full-stack Engineer 5                                            Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.
